notes: Ethereum mainnet (chainId 1). SIMDTESTToken is the only application implementation; contracts is empty and no initialization calls are required. Constructor arguments in declaration order are $factory (address), $poolManager (address) and $launchNumber (uint64). The factory must be the constructor caller, have deployed code and differ from PoolManager and the burn address. The PoolManager argument must equal 0x000000000004444c5dc75cB358380D2e3dE08A90. The constructor credits the entire fixed supply to msg.sender once; no owner, admin, upgrade, subsequent mint or supply-reducing burn functions exist. The external launch factory performs distributor funding, single-sided pool seeding within economics.poolBps and remainder forwarding to economics.remainderTo. Transfers to the burn address leave totalSupply unchanged. The required pool fee is 3000 (0.30%) with tickSpacing 60; the earlier 1.25% prose is superseded by the mandatory launch requirements. The separate token fee is floor(amount * 300 / 10000), charged only when from is PoolManager and to is not PoolManager; the contract retains this fee. All transfers into PoolManager, ordinary wallet transfers and dividend payouts are fee-free. Dividends accrue on eligible balances before crediting each net purchase, so newly purchased tokens do not earn their own fee. PoolManager, the token contract, burn address, zero address, factory and registered distributor are excluded. The factory must support distributorOf(launchNumber) and register the distributor before launch distribution; the first nonzero result observed by a transfer is permanently cached. Anyone may call claim(), which pays only the caller and returns zero for excluded accounts or no whole-unit entitlement. Previously earned credit survives transferring or selling the full balance; receiving tokens earns no past dividends, and payout tokens earn only future distributions. Fractional account credit is retained, while global index rounding dust stays in the contract without a sweep function. When no eligible prior balance exists, fees queue until a subsequent taxed transfer with eligible prior holders; transfers without a fee and claim() do not flush the queue. Direct donations to the token contract are not credited as dividends and have no recovery function. The transfer-based fee also covers outgoing PoolManager liquidity withdrawals; trades using only ERC-6909 claims cause no token transfer or token fee. Routers must measure net recipient balance changes. initialPrice is provenance only. With S = 1000000000000000000000000000 and C = 2500000000000000000000, the recorded value is floor(sqrt(C / S) * 2^96) when SIMDTEST sorts below IMD as currency0. If SIMDTEST sorts above IMD as currency1, floor(sqrt(S / C) * 2^96) is 50108289675009586237282760313921. The final token address is not supplied; the launch factory determines the authoritative opening price from economics and actual sorted addresses. External SIMD creator-fee splitting is outside this token: the operator arranges 1% split equally between SIMD holders and IMD seat agents.
